Data.Description: List top-level targets (windows and browser tabs), or drill into one to extract its element tree.
Data.Usage: uip rpa uia snapshot capture [w/b-ref] [--project-dir <string>] [--remote] [--visualize] [--type { Default | CV }] [--framework { Default | UIA | AA | Java }] [--all-windows] [--folder-path <string>]

Arguments.Name: w/b-ref
Arguments.Description: Window or browser tab target reference (e.g: w1 or b3)

Options.Description: Execute the command on the remote machine.
Briefly highlight the target element during the operation (for visual confirmation).
What to capture. Default captures the programmatic elements of the application. CV runs computer-vision analysis and captures only the elements visible in the view. [default: Default]
UI scanning framework. Default is recommended for most apps, especially browsers.
Show all top-level windows in the rendered tree, disabling the default filtering
The folder to write the snapshot artifacts to. When omitted, a timestamped folder is created under the project's .local/.uia/.interact/output folder.
Governance policy to judge this invocation by where the signed-in tenant has none

GlobalOptions.Description: JMESPath expression applied to the Data field of the response envelope
Write logs to file instead of stderr
